info.title: CRX Manage API
info.description:
The operator console's API. Every console action is one of these routes.

Every request carries four headers: CRX-Key-Id, CRX-Timestamp (unix milliseconds), CRX-Nonce (16 to 64 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and -) and CRX-Signature.

CRX-Signature is the base64 Ed25519 signature, made with the key's private key, of these six lines joined by a line feed, with no line feed at the end:

CRX-MANAGE-V1, the method in capitals, the path with its query as sent (for example /api/v1/clients), the timestamp, the nonce, and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the body (of the empty string when there is no body).

A timestamp more than 120 seconds old or more than 5 seconds ahead, a nonce used before, an unknown or revoked key, or a bad signature answers 401. A key takes 60 requests a minute; past that, 429.

An API key holds a set of permissions (x-crx-permissions). Each operation a key may call names the one it needs (x-crx-permission); a call outside the key's set answers 403. A key made with a scope holds every permission of the operations its scope reaches (x-crx-scope).

Writes take a JSON body of at most 8 KB and an optional Idempotency-Key header, kept 24 hours. POST /kyb/cases/{caseId}/documents takes the file's bytes, at most 10 MB. A KYB write that the case's state refuses answers 409 with `reason`: missing_requirements (with `missing`), case_locked, duplicate_external_id (with `caseId`), case_exists (with `caseId` when the case is yours), duplicate_document (with `documentId`), link_unavailable or no_wallet_step.

keyId.name: CRX-Key-Id
keyId.description: The key id, mk_ followed by 16 hex characters.

nonce.name: CRX-Nonce
nonce.description: 16 to 64 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and -. Used once.

signature.name: CRX-Signature
signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature of the signing message.

field.description: The body field the error is about.

reason.description: KYB routes: why a conflict refused the write. One of missing_requirements, case_locked, duplicate_external_id, case_exists, duplicate_document, link_unavailable, no_wallet_step.

missing.description: KYB routes, reason missing_requirements: the items still due, each with key, section, code and message, and sections on crx_request.

caseId.description: KYB routes, reason duplicate_external_id: the case that holds the externalId; reason case_exists: the firm's case, when it is yours.

documentId.description: KYB routes, reason duplicate_document: the document already on the case.

bad_request.description: The request is malformed or a field is invalid. `field` names the field.

forbidden.description: The caller's role, or the key's permissions, do not allow this request.

not_found.description: No such resource for this operator.

conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state.

rate_limited.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this key.

unavailable.description: The service cannot complete the request now. No change was made.

get.summary: List one client's trades, newest first.
get.description:
Role: viewer. API key scope: read or higher.

Answer: `{available: true}` with trades and `next`, the cursor of the next page or null. A trade: id, pair, side, notional, notionalCurrency, rate, valueDate, status (`pending`, `open`, `closed` or `refused`), openedAt, closedAt, and pnlUsd, the result the client's desk shows or null. Null where the client's account holds no value: side (a leg whose side the account does not show), rate, valueDate (a refused trade), openedAt (a trade still being sent), closedAt (not closed), notionalCurrency (a pair that does not parse), pnlUsd (an open trade, or no fixing yet). The list holds every open and pending trade and the most recent closed trades. `truncated` is true when older closed trades exist and are not listed. A client whose account data is not open to the operator answers `{available: false}` and no other field.

200.description: `{available: true}` with trades and `next`, the cursor of the next page or null. A trade: id, pair, side, notional, notionalCurrency, rate, valueDate, status (`pending`, `open`, `closed` or `refused`), openedAt, closedAt, and pnlUsd, the result the client's desk shows or null. Null where the client's account holds no value: side (a leg whose side the account does not show), rate, valueDate (a refused trade), openedAt (a trade still being sent), closedAt (not closed), notionalCurrency (a pair that does not parse), pnlUsd (an open trade, or no fixing yet). The list holds every open and pending trade and the most recent closed trades. `truncated` is true when older closed trades exist and are not listed. A client whose account data is not open to the operator answers `{available: false}` and no other field.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `open`, `closed` or `all`. Default: `all`. `open` leaves out `pending` and `closed` leaves out `refused`: both come with `all` alone.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time with `Z` or an offset: trades opened at or after it. In a raw URL, encode `+` as `%2B`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most trades to answer, 1 to 200. Default: 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next` value of the previous answer: the page after it.

get.summary: Read the clients' trade figures by month, by day and by period.
get.description:
Role: viewer. Console session only; API keys are refused.

Answer: `{available: true}` with months, days and periods. `months`, newest first: the current New York month back to the month of the oldest trade listed, 6 at the least and 60 at the most. A month: month (`YYYY-MM`), volumeUsd (the USD notional of the trades the clients opened in the month, at the cent), trades, clients (the clients that opened one), and unpriced (trades with no USD notional, left out of volumeUsd). `days`, oldest first: the last 365 New York days, today the last, one row a day with the same figures and day (`YYYY-MM-DD`) in place of month. `periods`: the last 7, 30, 90 and 365 New York days, today included, each with days (7, 30, 90 or 365) and the same figures; its clients counts a client once in the period. A trade counts on the New York day and in the month it opened. `partial`: clients whose account lists only their recent trades; `unread`: clients whose figures could not be read and are left out. With no client figures on file, `{available: false}` and no other field.

200.description: `{available: true}` with months, days and periods. `months`, newest first: the current New York month back to the month of the oldest trade listed, 6 at the least and 60 at the most. A month: month (`YYYY-MM`), volumeUsd (the USD notional of the trades the clients opened in the month, at the cent), trades, clients (the clients that opened one), and unpriced (trades with no USD notional, left out of volumeUsd). `days`, oldest first: the last 365 New York days, today the last, one row a day with the same figures and day (`YYYY-MM-DD`) in place of month. `periods`: the last 7, 30, 90 and 365 New York days, today included, each with days (7, 30, 90 or 365) and the same figures; its clients counts a client once in the period. A trade counts on the New York day and in the month it opened. `partial`: clients whose account lists only their recent trades; `unread`: clients whose figures could not be read and are left out. With no client figures on file, `{available: false}` and no other field.

get.summary: List the fields and documents a KYB case takes, and the countries CRX onboards.
get.description:
Role: viewer. API key scope: read or higher.

Answer: `fields`: key, section, type (`string`, `boolean`, `number` or `choice`) and label, with choices (each a `value` and its `label`), maxLength, format and help (when the field applies) where they apply. `sections`: business, eligibility, people, ownership and documents, in order. `countries`: the countries a case may name, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. `documents`: each document a case may ask: key (the CRX-Requirement value of its upload), label and help (when CRX asks it).

200.description: `fields`: key, section, type (`string`, `boolean`, `number` or `choice`) and label, with choices (each a `value` and its `label`), maxLength, format and help (when the field applies) where they apply. `sections`: business, eligibility, people, ownership and documents, in order. `countries`: the countries a case may name, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. `documents`: each document a case may ask: key (the CRX-Requirement value of its upload), label and help (when CRX asks it).

fields.label: Principal place of business is different
fields.help: true when the firm runs its business from an address other than its registered office.

choices.label: A regulated financial firm: bank, broker-dealer, FCM, insurer or investment company

documents.label: Certificate of incorporation
documents.help: The certificate the company register issued for the firm.

documents.label: Tax form
documents.help: A US firm: IRS Form W-9. A firm outside the US: IRS Form W-8BEN-E or W-8IMY.

get.summary: List the KYB cases you opened through the API, newest first.
get.description:
Role: viewer. API key scope: read or higher.

Answer: `data`: one item a case: caseId, externalId, firmId, state, version, returns and updatedAt. `hasMore`, and `nextCursor`: the cursor of the next page, or null. GET /kyb/cases/{caseId} reads a case in full.

200.description: `data`: one item a case: caseId, externalId, firmId, state, version, returns and updatedAt. `hasMore`, and `nextCursor`: the cursor of the next page, or null. GET /kyb/cases/{caseId} reads a case in full.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` value of the previous answer: the page after it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most cases to answer, 1 to 100. Default: 20.

post.summary: Open a KYB case for a client firm.
post.description:
Role: reviewer. API key scope: write or higher.

A contact address that is no company address, CRX's or your own firm's answers 400 with `field` contact.email; a firm linked to another operator, 409. An externalId already on one of your cases answers 409 with reason `duplicate_external_id` and that case's `caseId`; a firm that already has a case, 409 with reason `case_exists`, and its `caseId` when the case is yours.

Answer: The case.

due.message: Name each person who owns 25% or more of the firm.

externalId.description: Optional. Your own id for the client, unique among your cases, at most 100 characters.

country.description: The country of registration: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, one of `countries` of GET /kyb/fields, for example `GB`.

contact.description: The client's contact: `name` and `email`, a company address. The client firm is the address's firm.

get.summary: Read one KYB case: its state, its steps, what is due, its people and its documents.
get.description:
Role: viewer. API key scope: read or higher.

CRX sends each signer the link to sign CRX's documents. `requirements.waiting` lists each signer CRX still sends a link to: code `signing_link`, with the `personKey`. `people[].signature.state` shows `to_sign`, then `signed`. CRX's request for more information is the due item `crx_request`: its text in `message`, the sections it reopens in `sections`.

Answer: The case: caseId, externalId, firmId (the client firm, as GET /clients/{firmId} names it, or null), state (`preparing`, `in_progress`, `with_crx`, `approved`, `declined` or `closed`; `invited` for clients CRX invites: an API case goes from `preparing` to `in_progress`), version, returns (the count of CRX's requests for more information so far), createdAt, updatedAt, firmName, country, steps (key, and state: `not_started`, `current`, `waiting` or `done`), requirements (`due`: key, section, code and message, and sections on `crx_request`; `waiting`: who, code and message, and personKey when the item names a person), people (personKey, roles, the ID check's state and the signature's state), documents, and decision (outcome and decidedAt, or null). `version` rises by 1 at each change of the case.

200.description: The case: caseId, externalId, firmId (the client firm, as GET /clients/{firmId} names it, or null), state (`preparing`, `in_progress`, `with_crx`, `approved`, `declined` or `closed`; `invited` for clients CRX invites: an API case goes from `preparing` to `in_progress`), version, returns (the count of CRX's requests for more information so far), createdAt, updatedAt, firmName, country, steps (key, and state: `not_started`, `current`, `waiting` or `done`), requirements (`due`: key, section, code and message, and sections on `crx_request`; `waiting`: who, code and message, and personKey when the item names a person), people (personKey, roles, the ID check's state and the signature's state), documents, and decision (outcome and decidedAt, or null). `version` rises by 1 at each change of the case.

post.summary: Save answers on a case. A field given as null is cleared.
post.description:
Role: reviewer. API key scope: write or higher.

A value that is not valid answers 400 with `field`. Rules that join several answers run when the section is confirmed.

Answer: The case.

200.description: The case.

due.message: Name each person who owns 25% or more of the firm.

fields.description: An object: a field key of GET /kyb/fields → its value, or null to clear it.

post.summary: Confirm a section of a case: business, eligibility, people or ownership.
post.description:
Role: reviewer. API key scope: write or higher.

Another section answers 400 with `field` section; POST /kyb/cases/{caseId}/documents/done closes the documents step. An answer that is not valid answers 400 with `field`. A case that is not complete answers 409 with reason `missing_requirements` and `missing`, the items still due.

Answer: The case.

200.description: The case.

due.message: Name each person who owns 25% or more of the firm.

post.summary: Upload one document to a case: PDF, PNG or JPEG, at most 10 MB.
post.description:
Role: reviewer. API key scope: write or higher.

The body is the file's bytes, with Content-Type application/pdf, image/png or image/jpeg; the signature hashes those bytes. A file already on the case answers 409 with reason `duplicate_document` and its `documentId`.

Answer: The document: documentId, requirement, filename, contentType, size, sha256 and uploadedAt.

201.description: The document: documentId, requirement, filename, contentType, size, sha256 and uploadedAt.

parameters.name: CRX-Filename
parameters.description: The file name: 1 to 200 characters, with no / or \.

parameters.name: CRX-Requirement
parameters.description: The requirement the file meets: the `key` of a document item the case lists as due. `documents` of GET /kyb/fields names each.

post.summary: Remove a document from a case. CRX keeps the file on record.
post.description:
Role: reviewer. API key scope: write or higher.

Answer: The case.

200.description: The case.

due.message: Name each person who owns 25% or more of the firm.

post.summary: Mark the documents step of a case done.
post.description:
Role: reviewer. API key scope: write or higher.

A case that is not complete answers 409 with reason `missing_requirements` and `missing`, the items still due.

Answer: The case.

200.description: The case.

due.message: Name each person who owns 25% or more of the firm.

post.summary: Get a link to a person's ID check, on a CRX page. The person's previous link stops working.
post.description:
Role: reviewer. API key scope: write or higher.

Each person gives consent on CRX's ID check page. A person whose ID check is done or not open yet: 409 with reason `link_unavailable`; `message` names the cause and the next step. A personKey that is not on the case: 404.

Answer: `url`, the link, and `expiresAt`.

200.description: `url`, the link, and `expiresAt`.

post.summary: Answer the wallet step of a case: the client adds its wallet in Discover.
post.description:
Role: reviewer. API key scope: write or higher.

The step opens once business, eligibility, people and ownership are confirmed. A case with no wallet step: 409 with reason `no_wallet_step`. After the decision: 409 with reason `case_locked`.

Answer: The case.

200.description: The case.

due.message: Name each person who owns 25% or more of the firm.

type.description: `none`: no wallet address on the case; the client adds the wallet in Discover.

custody.description: Optional. How the client holds its assets: `fireblocks`, `bitgo`, `other` (with custodian) or `self_hosted`.

custodian.description: Optional. With custody `other`: the custodian's name.

post.summary: Send a case to CRX for review.
post.description:
Role: reviewer. API key scope: write or higher.

A case that is not complete answers 409 with reason `missing_requirements` and `missing`, the items still due. The last signature can send the case to CRX first: submit then answers the case unchanged.

Answer: The case.

200.description: The case.

post.summary: Withdraw a case before CRX decides.
post.description:
Role: reviewer. API key scope: write or higher.

Answer: The case.

200.description: The case.

due.message: Name each person who owns 25% or more of the firm.
